emotion_goal: Trust, clarity, privacy, and calm. A smart financial workspace, not a flashy fintech app.

layout.spacing: Dense but optical. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard widgets.

buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E2] text-[#1A2E25] hover:bg-[#F9F9F8] rounded-md

navigation.style: Sidebar or top nav with solid background (bg-white), 1px bottom/right border. No glassmorphism for finance data clarity.

shadcn_customization.instruction: Override default border radii to 6px or 8px (rounded-md/lg). Change primary ring color to deep forest green (#1A2E25). Avoid default slate/gray.
shadcn_customization.tables: Dense padding, subtle row hover backgrounds (bg-[#F0F0EE]/50), clean column alignments.

image_urls.description: Minimalist calm workspace with a potted plant, ideal for the login/signup page split-screen background.
Clear drinking glass on wooden table. Good for 'No reports generated yet' or 'Workspace empty' states.

accessibility_and_motion.motion: Minimal. Use subtle translate-y-[-2px] on interactive cards. Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) for dashboard widgets on load.
accessibility_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-csv-button').
accessibility_and_motion.contrast: Ensure text contrast against background. Do not use pure gray (#808080); use the tinted secondary/muted colors provided.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind classes matching the hex codes provided (configure in tailwind.config.js).
Implement the Layout using CSS Grid with subgrid where applicable to maintain alignment across cards.
For the AI Insights page, use the 'ai_panel' styling for the primary cards to visually distinguish AI-generated content from standard data.
The login page should feature a split layout: clean white form on one side, and the 'auth_background' image on the other side with a subtle black/10 overlay if needed.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. Import and configure 'Manrope' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text via Google Fonts.
Use Shadcn UI for complex components like Datepickers and Select dropdowns, but strip away the default Vercel-like styling to match the flat, organic aesthetic.
